summary.note: int8's frozen c_op1_sha256 hashes int64 values (2,048 bytes), so it never equals the card's 1,024-byte C; its values are compared here

c6_files.make_blind6_check: make_blind6.py --check sums every file in its directory (v1's fault 2), so any file beside the pool, this note's included, makes it report one problem, MISMATCH SHA256SUMS, while the files it builds still compare equal; the checks above are the pool's check
